scope: Prospective laboratory-runner hardening only; no REA product/core, native/browser, README or documentation edits by this task.
hardening: Assess both status and full_acceptance only after final cleanup and token-log inspection.
Require target exit code 0 and signal null; a refused listener alone is insufficient.
Retain cleanup and private-session removal rejection as failure facts rather than skipping final assessment.
Bind the assessment helper bytes with all other runtime harness inputs.

historical_trial.note: Historical observations and executed work source are unchanged. The 61/58/3 unit fixture tests classification, not native behavior.

independent_review.scope: Persistent runner/helper/tests compared against the executed work source; no native execution.

limitations: Pure assessment tests validate decision semantics, not actual process cleanup or a full pilot rerun.
The runner retains size and five-parameter call warnings; these were not hidden or suppressed.
